At Allianz, technology never replaces human judgment. Every application is carefully reviewed by our recruiting teams, ensuring a fair, thoughtful, and personal hiring process.The Global Operational & Business Risk Management team is the independent second-line function responsible for overseeing operational and business risks across Allianz Global Investors. The team provides risk analysis, advice, and constructive challenge to the business and control functions across the organisation.The Senior ICT (Information & Communication Technology) Risk Manager plays a leading role in the independent oversight of ICT and digital risks across Allianz Global Investors. The role combines a sound understanding of technology with strong risk management judgement and translates complex ICT topics into clear risk assessments, management implications, and practical challenge.What you will do- Lead independent second-line oversight and challenge of ICT risks across infrastructure, applications, information security, technology development and change, operations, transformations, and system changes, with a particular focus on resilience, security, critical business services, and client impact.- Provide risk-based challenge of material technology architecture and cloud decisions, particularly where these may affect resilience, security, data protection, or third-party dependencies.- Oversee ICT incidents from a second-line perspective, challenging impact assessments, root cause analyses, remediation activities, and lessons learned to identify systemic weaknesses and recurring risk themes.- Review and challenge material findings from ICT security and resilience testing, including vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and DORA-related testing, and oversee the risk-based remediation of identified weaknesses.- Maintain awareness of the evolving cyber threat and technology landscape, including risks arising from cloud services, digitalisation, artificial intelligence, and external technology providers, and assess the implications for the ICT risk profile, resilience scenarios, and risk and control assessments.- Develop and maintain ICT-related risk frameworks, control expectations, methodologies, and taxonomies, and contribute to the effective implementation of DORA and other relevant regulatory and internal requirements.What you bring- At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in ICT/Technology Risk, Operational Risk, Information Security, Technology Audit or a comparable risk/control function, ideally within financial services or another regulated environment.- Practical knowledge of ICT risk management and controls, including risk assessments, control design and effectiveness, scenario analysis and key risk indicators.- Strong understanding of ICT governance, information security, operational resilience, business continuity, third-party/cloud risk and technology change.- Sound understanding of DORA and its implications for ICT risk, operational resilience, incident management and third-party risk.- Experience assessing and challenging ICT risks, controls, incidents, deficiencies and remediation plans, and communicating material risks to senior stakeholders and governance committees.- Familiarity with relevant control assurance and technology frameworks, such as ISAE 3402, SOC, COBIT, ITIL, ISO/IEC 27001 or the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.- University degree in IT, Computer Science, Business, Economics, Finance, Risk Management or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.- Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technology topics into clear business and risk language.- Independent, pragmatic and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in an international environment.- Excellent English; German or another European language is an advantage.- Additional advantages: Relevant certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP or CISM, experience in asset management, and exposure to technology transformation, AI-related risks or frameworks such as COBIT, ITIL, ISO/IEC 27001 or NIST CSF.What we offer- We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours)- Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans- Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities)- Company share purchasing plan- Mental health and wellbeing programs- Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket)- Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group- Self-guided learning & development- … and so much more!

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor of Marketing (f/m/d) (Professor/in - Hochschulen)
jobs.description: Constructor University is a private, state-accredited, English-language research university located on a green, 34-hectare residential campus in Bremen, Germany. Founded in 2001, the university offers Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD programs across three schools: the School of Science, the School of Computer Science and Engineering, and the School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences. Constructor University is home to approximately 2,500 students and researchers from more than 120 countries. All teaching, research, and academic administration are conducted in English, within an international community that is among the most diverse of any university in Germany. According to the 2027 Times Higher Education World University Rankings, Constructor University ranks among the top 17 percent of universities worldwide in both Social Sciences and Engineering; moreover, it scores 92 out of 100 for International Outlook and 84 out of 100 for Industry. The indicators that reflect both the quality of its academic environment and the breadth of its engagement with the wider world.The School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences brings together management, behavioral science, data analytics, and decision theory under one roof. Its programs, ranging from undergraduate studies in International Business Administration to the MBA, MSc in Data Science for Society and Business, and doctoral education, attract professionally ambitious and internationally minded students. The School is also home to approximately 50 doctoral researchers, contributing to an active and growing research environment. Marketing represents a strategic new direction for the School, and this position offers an opportunity to help shape the field from the outset, develop an independent research agenda in a genuinely interdisciplinary environment, and contribute to a School that is actively expanding.Constructor University invites applications for the following position, to be filled ideally by Fall 2027:Assistant Professor of Marketing (f/m/d)(Full-time; 38,5h/week, tenure-track)School of Business, Social and Decision SciencesYour Responsibilities:In this position, you will support our research and teaching activities in the field of Marketing. The successful candidate will be teaching courses (for example Digital Marketing), supporting and advising students on their studies and supervising Bachelor, Master’s and PhD theses and research projects.Possible areas of interest are: - Design and teach innovative, contemporary modules in Marketing at undergraduate and master’s levels, including within MBA, MA, and MSc programs.- Engage, advise, and mentor students; supervise Bachelor’s, Master’s theses, and doctoral research- Build and sustain an active research agenda with publications in leading peer-reviewed journals- Establish a research group and pursue external funding from national and international sources- Contribute to curriculum development, new program initiatives, and departmental serviceThe university is highly supportive of junior faculty, providing both formal and informal mentoring, administrative support, as well as a flexible budget for establishing an internationally visible research group. Several opportunities exist to develop transdisciplinary research projects in collaboration with other research groups or our industrial partners.Your Qualifications and Experience:- PhD in Marketing or a closely related field- Evidence of high-quality research and a strong publication pipeline- Ability to design and teach core Marketing courses at undergraduate and graduate levels- Expertise in areas such as Digital Marketing, Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behavior, AI in Marketing, or related fields is particularly welcome- Readiness to pursue external research funding and contribute to collaborative research projects- Ability and willingness to supervise Bachelor’s and Master’s theses and contribute to doctoral supervision- Willingness to work and teach in a multicultural, English-speaking academic environment- Excellent written and spoken English and strong intercultural competenceWhat you can expect at Constructor University: Constructor University guarantees the academic freedom of every faculty member. Junior faculty receive formal and informal mentoring, administrative support, and dedicated start-up and research group budgets to help establish their work. The university has an active portfolio of Horizon Europe and Erasmus+ funded projects and a culture of interdisciplinary collaboration across its three schools, creating genuine opportunities for joint initiatives and externally funded research. Beyond the academic environment, you will find a campus that is genuinely close-knit: small classes, direct faculty-student engagement, and a community where diversity is lived rather than declared. Language courses and sports facilities are part of everyday life on campus. Constructor University consistently achieves top results in national and international university rankings, in the CHE Ranking, the most comprehensive and detailed ranking of the German-speaking higher education landscape, Constructor University has achieved top placements every year since its first participation in 2005. The campus is located in Bremen. Bremen is a vibrant, livable Hanseatic city with an international character, affordable by European standards, well connected by rail and air, and home to a growing academic and innovation community. Relocating here is, for most, a pleasant discovery.The position is tenure-track, with review after an initial three-year contract, followed by a second three-year contract. Successful evaluation leads to permanence and typically promotion to Associate Professor level. Constructor University is an equal opportunity employer and particularly welcomes applications that would improve the university’s faculty profile with reference to gender and national origin.Your Application:If you have any questions about the position, please contact Prof. Dr. Çağrı Bulut via Mail (cbulut@constructor.university (https://mailto:cbulut@constructor.university) ).Constructor University offers full equal opportunity to all qualified applications. We value diversity and inclusion and encourage all qualified people to apply. We especially encourage applications from traditionally underrepresented groups.Please upload your documents in a single PDF document, including a letter of motivation stating your field of expertise, curriculum vitae, teaching portfolio, publication record, copies of certificates and diplomas, certification of English proficiency (optional), and the names and addresses of two referees in our application management system.The deadline for submission of applications 15.01.2027.The review of applications will begin immediately.Please note that only applications submitted through the official application portal will be considered for recognition.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
